it.permissions.readsTheProjectAnd: Legge il progetto e lancia comandi che non cambiano niente. Ogni scrittura viene rifiutata.
it.permissions.writesOnItsOwn: Scrive da sola dentro la cartella della sessione; per scrivere un file fuori ti chiede. I comandi passano dal cancello, che chiede per i posti delicati (la casa, il progetto, le cartelle del telefono), non per ogni cartella fuori.

en.permissions.readsTheProjectAnd: Reads the project and runs commands that change nothing. Every write is refused.
en.permissions.writesOnItsOwn: Writes on its own inside the session folder; writing a file outside it asks you. Commands go through the gate, which asks for sensitive places (home, the project, the phone's folders), not for every folder outside.
en.permissions.asksYouToConfirm: Asks you to confirm before every action that leaves a trace: writes, commands, network.
en.permissions.filesAndNetworkWithout: Files and network without the ordinary gates. Only if you already know what it is about to do.
